senses.gloss: (b. h.) [to turn, v. עוּד,] to be round, smooth, pliant. Pi. עִידֵּן

units: <cite ref="Moed Katan 16b:26">M. Kat. 16ᵇ</cite> (play on <he>עדינו</he>, <cite ref="II Samuel 23:8">II Sam. XXIII, 8</cite>) <he>כשהיה … היה מְעַדֵּן עצמו וכ׳</he> when sitting and studying the Law, he made himself pliant like a worm, opp. <he>מקשה עצמו</he> stiffening one’s self.

senses.gloss: to smooth, lubricate, to improve (the complexion); to refresh, invigorate.
units: <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:2">Cant. R. to I, 2</cite> <he>מה שמן מְעַדֵּן … מְעַדְּנִים וכ׳</he> as oil brightens the appearance of the head and the body, so the words of the Law &c.
<cite ref="Pesachim 43a:3">Pes. 43ᵃ</cite> <he>משיר … ומעדן את הבשר</he> makes the hair fall out and improves the complexion.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 6:1:18">Y. Ber. VI, 10ᵇ</cite> top <he>אשר … מעדנים לעַדֵּן בהן וכ׳</he> who created all sorts of delicacies to refresh therewith the soul &c.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 16:5">Gen. R. s. 16</cite> <he>עִדְּנוֹ מכל אילני וכ׳</he> he nursed him (with fruits) of all the trees of the garden of Eden; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 16:5">ib.</cite> <he>לעַדְּנוֹ וכ׳</he> he had intended to nurse him &c.

<cite ref="Shabbat 33b:5">Sabb. 33ᵇ</cite> <he>מרחצאות לעַדֵּן בהן עצמן</he> (Ms. M. <he>לֵעָרֵן בהן</he>; Yalk. Ms. <he>להִתְעַדֵּן</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) (the Romans have erected baths) for their own enjoyment (not for the benefit of the people); <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 2b:11">Ab. Zar. 2ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 316">Yalk. Is. 316</cite>.

Sifré Deut. 306 כל זמן … היו מערבים ומעדנים ומפנקים וכ׳ as long as my son does my will, humor him, nurse him and indulge him and give him to eat and to drink; Yalk. Deut. 942 היו מְעַדְּנִין וכ׳. Sifré l. c. מה רביבים … ומעדנים וכ׳ as the rains come down on the plants and brighten them and embellish them &c.; Yalk. l. c; a. fr.—Part. pass. מְעוּדָּן

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nedarim 9:9:2">Y. Ned. IX, end, 41ᶜ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="II Samuel 1:24">II Sam. I, 24</cite>) <he>אין תכשיט … גוף מע׳</he> ornamentation becomes only a well-nursed (graceful) body.—
senses.label: a

senses.gloss: indulged, used to luxuries. Mekh. Mishp. s. 8 אם היה מרוכך מע׳ מפונק if the wounded man was delicately reared, used to comfort and luxuries; Yalk. Ex. 339.
senses.label: b

units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 10:5">Gen. R. s. 10</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Job 38:31">Job XXXVIII, 31</cite> <he>מעדנות וכ׳</he>) <he>כימה מַעֲדֶנֶת וכ׳</he> the Kimah binds (gives substance and shape to) the fruits; cmp. <cite ref="M00779"><he>מָזַר</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: to be made smooth, pliable; to be rejuvenated; to be nursed, recover strength.
units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 120a:2">B. Bath. 120ᵃ</cite> <he>נ׳ הבשר ונתפשטו וכ׳</he> the body was again made smooth, the wrinkles of age were straightened out, and beauty returned &c.; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 165:1">Yalk. Ex. 165</cite>.

<cite ref="Nedarim 8b:6">Ned. 8ᵇ</cite> <he>מִתְעַדְּנִין בה</he> the righteous will be rejuvenated by it (by basking in the sun). Pesik. Haḥod., p. 102ᵃ <he>יִתְעַדֵּן בני וכ׳</he> let my son be nursed with food and drink for two or three months; <he>יִתְעַדְּנוּ בני וכ׳</he> let my children be nursed &c.; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:5">Cant. R. to II, 5</cite>; <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 3:11">Koh. R. to III, 11</cite>; a. fr.
